fact: The Commune of Ouagadougou launched street addressing (marking of street names and door numbers) in arrondissements 5 and 12 on 2 April 2025, covering over 2,277 streets and 43,000 doors, following arrondissements 1 and 2, with European Union support, according to the head of the city's special delegation.
system: Adressage de la ville de Ouagadougou
